name: Sound Novel Gekijou: Natsu no Ki ni Sumu Nymph
original_name: サウンドノベル劇場 夏の樹に棲む妖精
source: Sound Novel Gekijou: Natsu no Ki ni Sumu Nymph is the premade story featured in Sound Novel Tsukuru; a software allowing people to create their own sound novels.
translation: 《音响小说剧场：栖于夏树的妖精》是《音响小说制作大师》中预先收录的故事；后者是一款允许用户创作自己音响小说的软件。
